meta.title: Tenacity Client: the official Minecraft 1.8.9 client
meta.description: التحديث الرسمي المدعوم لعميلنا المفضل الكلاسيكي.
meta.offer: Included free with an Opal or Terminus license.

landing.customize: Customize Tenacity to your liking with our 3 ClickGUIs and 20+ pre-made themes

what.a: Tenacity is a Minecraft 1.8.9 utility client, first released in March 2021. This is its officially endorsed continuation, maintained by the team behind Opal, rebuilt to run on modern Java with a new renderer and a new scripting engine.

get.a: Tenacity comes free with <purchase>Opal</purchase> or Terminus. It is not sold on its own. Buy either one, then sign in to the <dashboard>dashboard</dashboard> with the same account to download Tenacity.

owner.q: I already own Opal or Terminus. What now?
owner.a: Sign in to the <dashboard>dashboard</dashboard> with the email you bought it with. Tenacity is already on your account.

real.a: Yes. tenacity.rip is the official, endorsed home of Tenacity and the only place to get current builds. Copies from anywhere else are not ours and are not safe to run.

expire.a: No. Access is lifetime, including future updates, as long as you follow our <terms>Terms of Service</terms>.

version.q: Which Minecraft version does Tenacity run on?

scripts.a: Yes. Scripts can be written in JavaScript, TypeScript or Lua. The <docs>docs</docs> cover the API, bindings and examples.

legal.prevails: تم توفير هذا الترجمة للتسهيل. في حال وجود اختلاف مع النسخة الإنجليزية، تبقى النسخة الإنجليزية هي السائدة.
